mapper.select: -- GET 조건 조회는 read-only다. 실제 예약만 source 잠금 뒤 정책/규칙 공유 잠금으로 게시 변경과 직렬화한다. SELECT p.id AS policy_id,p.policy_status_code,p.mode_code,p.rule_release_id,r.release_status_code, p.policy_hash,p.settings_json::text AS settings_json,p.profile_manifest_json::text AS profile_manifest_json,p.row_version FROM announcement_attachment_policies p JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=p.rule_release_id WHERE p.rule_release_id=#{ruleReleaseId} AND p.policy_status_code='ACTIVE' AND r.release_status_code='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE OF p,r
